title: Tiger-reserve trip prep: signs before stripes
storyboard: Film: trip lead briefing a group at a reserve gate with a tiger-sign ID card; close-up of the card
caption:
Most of a tiger trip is reading the forest

Tigers evolved in cooler forests of eastern Asia and handle heat less well than other big cats - one likely reason they take to water.
